name: Momofuku Bossam (Korean Slow-Roasted Pork Shoulder)
method: oven bake (low-and-slow roast, then high-heat crust)
ingredients: 3.5-4 kg / 7-8 lb pork butt/shoulder, bone in & skinless
1 tbsp kosher or cooking salt (brown sugar crust)
2.5 cups scallions, thinly sliced (ginger shallot sauce)
1/2 cup fresh ginger, peeled and finely grated
why: Distinct Korean pork-shoulder roast not in the catalog (Korean shredded-pork BOWLS exist, but bossam is a salt/sugar-cured slow-roast eaten in lettuce with ssam sauce, no starch base). Published 626 cal / 67g protein / 18g carbs per serving verified on-page - in band and huge protein, but 626 sits near the 650 ceiling so our computed macros could nudge over; flag for the selector. Batch-scalable as a weigh-and-divide pork roast; the optional rice/oyster garnish is dropped (no seafood). Multiple unmapped signature ingredients (gochujang, ssamjang, soy) - good pricer-lane fodder.
confidence: high on nutrition (read from page); medium on gate-survival due to 626 cal near ceiling
